name: Defaults that protect
rule: Keep risky or costly options off by default, so turning them on takes a deliberate choice.

leaders.note: Apps start sandboxed. Sensitive access is requested in context, needs an explicit user choice, and a denial is respected. Unused permissions reset to denied over time.
Advises least privilege. Restricted keys grant only the access a task needs. Secret keys are shown once. IP limits are opt-in. Sandbox keys are the safer default for testing.
